_comment: Cross-implementation golden vector. Every SDK (Rust core, browser cyg.js) must reproduce these exact bytes for this schema and these rows. Hex, lowercase, no separators. Regenerate only with `cargo run -p engine-webrtc-protocol --example gold_gen`, and re-derive the bit payload by hand before trusting it.
notes: kind byte: 5 = full, 6 = patch; hash is little-endian; id is LEB128 (7 = one byte).
full bit payload is 8 (hp) + 8 (yaw) + 1 (alive) + 32 (score) = 49 bits = 7 bytes.
string stays byte-aligned after the bit payload: len u8 + utf8.
